content.comment_body: Hello, I'm using [product_name] [version_no] and I’d like to use the KP300 screen since it offers more functionalities than the TD screen. I have two questions: Can the KP300 screen be used with the base module, and how can I add more functions in the software as currently it only shows four available for the TD screen?

Yes, it's possible for [product_name] [article_no] to communicate with a KP300 Basic mono panel. There is an example available on the [company_name] website: HMI communication starting from [product_name] [version_no] (TIA Portal)

Hi, You can use [product_name] Basic [version_no] to create a project for the KP300. Running a simulation on PC allows you to view and test the HMI screen’s buttons even without connecting a KP300. Hope this helps.

Hello, I've gathered all the necessary equipment and, following help section links, attempted to connect the KP300 to the software. I've set up all required functions for the screen but am having trouble connecting. The cable is correct, so I suspect the IP address settings might be causing the issue.
Can you share screenshots of your connection settings—both within [product_name] and on the [product_name] module?
Could you also provide screenshots from the [product_name] module’s side?

No, that's actually a screenshot from an attempted connection. What I meant is a screenshot of the connection settings within the [product_name] module itself. You need to configure a connection here similar to how it's done in [product_name]. The [company_name] example illustrates this as well.
I hope this is the screenshot you were asking for.
I am referring to screenshots like these.
I've set this up identically, but I still can’t get any connection—whether downloading the program or connecting to the [product_name] module.
Is the connection passing through a router? If yes, what is the router’s IP address?
My connection setup is as follows: HMI connected to PC for program download; [product_name] module connected to PC for program download; Then, HMI is connected to the [product_name] module.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are working to integrate a KP300 HMI screen with [product_name] [version_no] to enable additional features compared to the TD screen. They’re encountering challenges with software that restricts the number of functions for the TD screen, as well as problems with connecting the HMI to the [product_name] module, particularly IP address configuration and settings alignment. Advice has been given on configuration steps, but the main connection issue remains unresolved, reflecting complications in usability and network setup.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect that integrating [product_name] [version_no] with the KP300 HMI screen will be simple, granting access to more functionalities than the TD screen offers, and that configuring the network and functions within the software will be straightforward and trouble-free.
